text:
sasha: We9ve got a DSAR to delete chats/files for user id=redacted123. Those items exist in nightly encrypted snapshots (s3://redwood-backups/2026/) encrypted with retired alias redwood-backup-v1.
sasha: Legal also noted an active vuln triage referencing this account. Need guidance: retention exception vs immediate deletion.
mike: If snapshots are immutable/versioned, removing live items won9t remove snapshots. Rewrap is possible but manual and needs old key access.
ada: Legal: place an immediate hold if the vuln triage might need the data. That blocks deletion until cleared.
ops-oncall: Ops steps:
ops-oncall: - mark retention DB: retention.holds.add(redacted123, reason="vuln-triage")
ops-oncall: - tag affected snapshots with Hold=VULN_TRIAGE
ops-oncall: - create ticket to prevent deletes on held objects
sasha: Can we redact live PII while keeping snapshots intact?
ops-oncall: Yes, run a live redaction patch and log the admin actor and commit for audit.
mike: RBAC: restrict kms:ReEncrypt and s3:GetObject for backup keys to backup-operator+legal-priv via approval flow. Add audit rule for kms:ReEncrypt/Decrypt with principal + request-id.
ada: Action items: sasha attach DSAR verification to retention ticket RE-2026-XXXX, ops apply hold tags and redact live data, mike draft RBAC PR and link it.
legal-bot: retention-exception created RE-2026-3421; linked VULN-2026-128.
